If she is sure that she will get MC at that time what she should do? Question: Is it obligetory to do Tawaf - e - wida 1.While returning from Umrah? 2.If some one period(MC) start at time of returning what she can do?. 3. If she is sure that she will get MC at that time what she should do? Answer ID: 23363 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1386/B=281/tb=1431) Tawaf-e-Wida is not fardh in umrah, rather it is mustahab. A woman in menstruation can return home without doing this very tawaf. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
